note: SLOTAB's own events (meetings, fundraisers, booster events) for the 2026-27 year. Editable at /admin -> 'SLOTAB Events'. Board meetings are the first Monday of the month at 6:00 PM; September moves a week because the first Monday is Labor Day. August 2026's meeting was pushed to Mon Aug 10 and has been held. Venue confirmed unchanged for 2026-27. Entries with an `href` link through to a dedicated event page (see featured-events.json) - keep the two dates in sync. The Fall Sports Parent Meeting (Mon Aug 17) is a SLOHS Athletics event rather than a SLOTAB one, carried here because SLOTAB presents at it and parents look for it on this calendar; hence the 'Athletics Event' label. Still needed: physicals night and the spring fundraiser.
